title: Starting state
note: Default golden capture and harness refresh share a UTC second timestamp name, <user>-home-YYYYMMDDTHHMMSSZ, beside the current golden. Later same-day captures use new names; an exact current-golden collision refuses golden_capture_destination_collision and teaches retrying after the second changes or choosing an explicit destination. Explicit paths remain as given; a first capture requires one. Source supports an inherit continuity_fingerprint of stable regular files, checked under the lease before setup and again before mission walking; continuity_lost refuses without starting on missing, changed or uncheckable state. This proves the file state prepared earlier in the same chain. macOS restore retries a failed captured-entry copy once, preserves the existing reset boundary, and refuses persistent failure with its unrestored-entry receipt. Live proof remains pending for that retry. macOS keeps the exact protected speakerRecognition and secondPassChecker CoreSpeech cache directories live across capture and reset, so unreadable generated artifacts never enter the golden. The legacy user TCC directory stays live when present. The bridge and Full Disk Access probes establish effective privacy grants on fresh Macs without that directory. The Claude desktop profile stays live on macOS, outside newly captured goldens. The sealed desktop probe opens Claude and checks its signed-in chat view after capture and restore. macOS reset removes the self-host Compose stack through its live daemon and reports stack_reachable with real counts; the client is pointed at the daemon socket Colima reports (colima status --json) because the restored home may carry no Colima docker context, a stopped Colima is started to list the stack and stopped again after verify, a runtime already running stays running, a daemon that still cannot list refuses docker_unreachable with recovery to start the runtime (colima start), a started runtime that will not stop refuses runtime_stop_failed, and a host with no runtime client passes unreachable. Live proof remains pending for that refusal.
